dimensions.note: Workflows accept model names and transport options but define, persist, or log no credentials; secret handling remains with caller-selected models and vault references.
Declarative workflows have no custom logging surface; Swamp records each model and nested-workflow step.
Transport failure is explicitly retained, exactly one success/failure drain branch runs, and drain failures propagate; empty exact scopes complete as a deliberate no-op.
Synthetic fixtures exercised success branching, deduplicated replay, transport failure with retry-state persistence, malformed contracts, empty exact scope, and all workflow validation.
The outbox owns deduplication and retry state, each transport call receives the notification dedupKey, and a replay producing no enqueue artifact dispatches nothing.
The send input now exactly matches the dependency's strict notification resource contract; transport remains an explicit caller-supplied payload/idempotencyKey/options contract.
The workflows open no files or connections and create no provider resources directly.
README and packaged fixtures use synthetic non-routable model names and generic incident content only.
